description: Builds src/Rask.Ui/Resources/ui-editor.js, the lazily loaded engine behind Ui.Editor: dotnet run --project scripts/tools/KitBundle -- build editor (no npm, no Node). Tiptap is npm's latest, every package of the family at one version (the tool's follow, daily); prosemirror-model is held to the last one whose serialised HTML is what Flux's live editor answers (no trailing semicolon in a style attribute).
